I received the BC04 I ordered yesterday and it's working fine. However, I've still not heard from a human and received a request to give you another review. I'm prepared to send the following but wanted to let you know before I do.
This is and my first are the only orders I've received with no issues.
I've had plenty of other things go wrong:

- Following the receipt of my initial order, I ordered a second set of Buy 1, Get 2 602s, waited, didn’t receive and eventually had to get refunded by Helium Deploy (HD’s representative encouraged me to get the refund).
- I turned around a bought a BSB Nerdqaxe++ and a Bitaxe Supra with the refund.
- Waited a long time. Had communication back and forth and was told the units were going to be shipped but had to clear customs. Eventually received a communication tha the order was lost, the units were unavailable and they were sorry. 
- I accepted 3 NerdQaxe++ in place of what I ordered.
- Received the 3 NerdQaxe++. One is working fine. One wss bad and I put an RMA request in the system. Waited for some time and eventually was told it had to be approved by the team Additionally, the second of 3 was problematic as well and I had to put in an RMA in for it as well.
- Ordered a Hammer X1 and it's working fine so I ordered another. Waited for it to be delivered only to be told the miner was out of stock. Didn't question how a miner could have been ordered because it was in stock only to be told it couldn't be delivered because it was out of stock. Anyway, accepted a Hammer BC04 in place of the X1. While waiting for this mner (which i now have received), realized that the X1 I thought I received was actually a BC04.
- Completed a favorable Google review in return for a $75 off $100 or more, yet when I finished, it told me that the email address where the link sent me was bad so I couldn’t receive the offer (FYI, the address I was given was (email hidden) I believe this is the CEO of the company so I don't know how his email is
Handed to the team · Compensation amount for lost hashrate is Mike's/Abel's to set; promised twice an

Tom, your account of it is accurate, and I'm not going to ask you to hold the review. You've been told twice that a compensation figure was coming and twice it didn't. That's the part we got wrong.

One correction only: the $75 from that bounced address was applied as store credit on your account on October 31, so that one is settled.

The compensation number for the hashrate you lost is Mike and Abel's to set. It's back in front of them with the full history. They're offline now, pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

I can do a call at 9:30am CT?
